**Finding submitted — deviation (high severity), NONCOMPETE.**

- **Responsive clauses reviewed:** § 12.4 (second instance, p0046 — the non-compete), § 12.3 (p0044 — freedom-of-action acknowledgment), § 12.4 (first instance, p0045 — no-hire, belongs to non-solicitation, not flagged here), § 13.4 (use restrictions, not competitive).
- **Problem:** p0046 binds Customer for the term plus 24 months, across "any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory" — walk-away territory (post-term > 12 months, undefined scope) and failing all five fallback elements. It also contradicts § 12.3.
- **Cure (preferred level, validated ok:true):** single surgical replace turning the prohibition into an affirmative confirmation of Customer's freedom of action, preserving the remaining words verbatim and removing the internal conflict with § 12.3. The narrowed fallback (named product, term only, 12 months, carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions) is offered in the comment.
